kali-server._comment: Official Kali MCP server. Available after apt install mcp-kali-server. Can invoke any terminal tool directly, such as nmap/nxc/curl/gobuster.

metasploit-mcp._comment: MCP interface to the Metasploit Framework. apt install metasploitmcp. Supports exploit, payload and session management.

hexstrike._comment: HexStrike AI MCP. apt install hexstrike-ai. Automated orchestration of 150+ security tools.

pentestswarm._comment: Pentest Swarm AI. A swarm-intelligence autonomous pentest framework. Install via go install or Docker. Supports --swarm mode.

anything-analyzer._comment: Browser automation plus HTTP capture. Clone it first and start it with pnpm dev.

idapro._comment: IDA Pro MCP. Requires the Linux build of IDA Pro plus the ida-pro-mcp plugin. The port may increment up to 13350.

ghidra._comment: Ghidra MCP. apt install ghidra plus the GhidraMCP plugin. A free alternative to IDA.
